# Foundation Checklist: Food Business Foundation

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review gate for the food-business foundation spec before planning
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: specs/005-food-business-foundation/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the 9 closed business types enumerated with exact canonical values in the requirements, not only as prose examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the core-four capabilities defined with per-capability meaning for each business type (what varies versus what is fixed)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are onboarding requirements specified for the owner-plus-request flow (required fields, approval, resulting storefront and dashboard)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are currency-change requirements specified (who can change, effective scope, treatment of historical order snapshots)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are pre-order reserve requirements specified as contract-only, with no engine behavior leaking into this feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "configurable capability" defined with explicit boundaries between data-driven settings and code changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the closed-type change process specified (what a later spec plus migration must contain to add a type)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the "forward-compatible expression" for pre-order defined with enough precision to prevent divergent interpretations? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "integer minor units" scoped explicitly across prices, fees, subtotals, totals, and snapshots? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the "presentation logic only" boundary for currency defined between formatting and math or storage? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are internal-naming requirements consistent between the Clarifications session (keep restaurant identifiers) and Key Entities (Food Business wording)? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are bookings and analytics exclusions consistent across FR-002, FR-013, and the capability set? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are currency requirements consistent between FR-006 (owner-editable) and Assumptions (snapshot behavior for prior orders)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are availability semantics consistent between Story 4 (behavior unchanged today) and FR-007 (reserved future expression)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Can SC-002 "100% of pre-feature checks" be objectively verified, with the check set enumerated or referenced? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are SC-001 time bounds scoped with defined start and end points for the measured checkout flow? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is SC-004 "0 cases of cross-currency mixing" defined with a testable assertion scope across menu, cart, checkout, and tracked orders? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the SC-006 SEO-essentials list complete, with each item verifiable and free of fabricated claims? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are alternate-flow requirements defined for delivery-disabled types, closed hours, and expired subscriptions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are exception-flow requirements defined for invalid currency or type values at write time? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are recovery and rollback requirements defined for failed migrations and for disabling the new capability surface? [Coverage, Spec §Migration]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are concurrent-ordering conflict requirements specified for write-time re-validation of totals, availability, hours, and subscription? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are unknown or missing business-type fallback requirements specified with exact default behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are missing or invalid currency fallback requirements specified with a documented default that preserves integer math? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are private-page non-indexing requirements specified for every new public surface added by this feature? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 - Are tenant-isolation requirements specified for all read and write paths in both directions between businesses? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are security non-weakening requirements enumerated per control rather than stated only as a general principle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are visual-identity freeze requirements specified with the exact token list and the gate for future changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are no-fabrication requirements specified for empty states when no verifiable proof exists yet? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 - Are migration safety requirements specified as additive, idempotent, safe-defaulted, with destructive changes gated? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the pre-feature acceptance baseline referenced by SC-002 documented or otherwise retrievable for verification? [Assumption, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are out-of-scope boundaries explicit for payments, React migration, homepage redesign, full i18n, and self-serve signup? [Completeness, Spec §Constraints]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Focus: scope and capabilities, data and money rules, NFRs and migration (reviewer, rigorous gate)
- 100% of items carry traceability references; no implementation-behavior assertions included
